summary: --- name: convex-best-practices description: Production patterns for Convex apps and the rules the @convex-dev/eslint-plugin enforces: validators, indexes, idempotent mutations, avoiding OCC conflicts, thin function wrappers, error handling. Use when reviewing Convex code, asking whether a pattern is right, setting up ESLint, or fixing write conflicts and slow queries. --- # Convex best practices The patterns that keep a Convex app fast and correct in production. The rule that matters most: read as little as possible before you write, and read through an index. ## Rules that matter most 1. Validators on every function. `args` and `returns`, with `returns: v.null()` when nothing comes back. 2. Indexes, not filters. Every table read goes through `withIndex` against an index in `convex/schema.ts`. 3. Idempotent mutations. Return early when the document is already in the target state so retries are safe.
type: skills
